leadText: Outland forlag is a publishing company headquartered in Norway. They publish comics and manga in Norwegian, including Pokémon manga.
plainText:
Outland forlag is a publishing company headquartered in Norway. They publish comics and manga in Norwegian, including Pokémon manga. 

==Pokémon titles licensed by Outland forlag==
Pokémon Adventures (regular tankōbon volumes; each arc with its own numbering)
(2021-2022, three volumes)
(2022, four volumes)
(2023-2025, eight volumes)
(2025-present, ongoing)
